text:
### Scope  
Applies to:
- All customers and accounts
- All transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers)
- All staff, contractors, and third parties
- All products and channels (branch, online, mobile)  
Does not apply to:
- Regulatory authorities
- Law enforcement
- Exempt entities (per HM Treasury guidance)  
---
name: Chunk 4/35

raw_entities.name: Anti-Money Laundering and Know Your Customer Policy
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive policy governing anti-money laundering and customer due diligence obligations across all customer accounts, transactions, and banking channels. The policy applies to all staff, contractors, and third parties, and covers all products and service delivery channels including branch, online, and mobile banking.
context: Applies to: All customers and accounts
All transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers)
All staff, contractors, and third parties
All products and channels (branch, online, mobile)

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: All natural persons who hold, apply for, or are otherwise the subject of a banking relationship under this policy. Customers are subject to KYC verification, AML screening, and transaction monitoring obligations across all accounts and products.
context: Applies to: All customers and accounts
All customers and accounts

raw_entities.name: Account
raw_entities.description: All customer accounts held at the bank, including savings and current accounts. Accounts are subject to KYC verification at opening and ongoing AML monitoring throughout their lifecycle.
context: Applies to: All customers and accounts
All transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers)

raw_entities.name: Transaction
raw_entities.description: All financial events on customer accounts including deposits, withdrawals, and transfers. Transactions are subject to monitoring and screening under the policy's AML obligations.
context: All transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers)

raw_entities.name: Product
raw_entities.description: All banking products offered across all channels including branch, online, and mobile platforms. Products are subject to the policy's AML and KYC requirements regardless of delivery channel.
context: All products and channels (branch, online, mobile)

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All employees, contractors, and third parties engaged by the bank. All staff are bound by the policy's obligations regarding customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
context: All staff, contractors, and third parties

raw_entities.name: Third Party
raw_entities.description: External parties engaged by the bank to perform functions or services. Third parties are subject to the same AML and KYC policy obligations as internal staff.
context: All staff, contractors, and third parties

raw_entities.name: Contractor
raw_entities.description: Contract workers and temporary staff engaged by the bank. Contractors are subject to the policy's AML and KYC obligations on the same basis as permanent employees.
context: All staff, contractors, and third parties

raw_entities.name: HM Treasury Guidance
raw_entities.description: Guidance issued by HM Treasury that defines exempt entities from the scope of this policy. The policy explicitly defers to Treasury guidance for determining which entities are exempt from AML and KYC requirements.
context: Exempt entities (per HM Treasury guidance)

raw_entities.name: Exempt Entity
raw_entities.description: Certain entities defined by HM Treasury guidance that are exempt from the policy's AML and KYC requirements. The policy explicitly excludes regulatory authorities and law enforcement from its scope.
context: Does not apply to: Regulatory authorities
Law enforcement
